reasoning_content: postgresql-18 got pulled in as a dependency of the "postgis" metapackage. Since the guide specifies PostgreSQL v15, I'll create a 15 cluster (the 18 cluster is currently occupying port 5432). Let me check the pnpm install progress and set up the 15 cluster:

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "tail -5 /tmp/pnpm-install.log; echo \"---\"; pg_createcluster 15 main --port=5432 --start 2>&1 | tail -3", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Check pnpm progress, create PG15 cluster"}

summary: Check pnpm progress, create PG15 cluster
